title: Lanthanide(III) Di- and Tetra-nuclear Complexes Supported by a Chelating Tripodal Tris(Amidate) Ligand

synthesis.procedure: Under argon/anaerobic conditions, finely ground LaBr3 (37 mg, 0.098 mmol) was added to a pale orange DMF (2 mL) solution of K3L^tBu (61 mg, 0.093 mmol). After LaBr3 dissolved (~15 min), volatiles were removed in vacuo (~1.5 h). The residue was extracted into toluene (3 mL), filtered through Celite, concentrated to <1 mL, and layered with hexanes (~5 mL). Storage at -35 °C for 24 h gave a white microcrystalline powder; X-ray-quality crystals were grown by toluene/hexane vapor diffusion.
synthesis.time: ~15 min dissolution; ~1.5 h drying; 24 h crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: salt metathesis in DMF; Celite filtration; layered crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: vacuum drying, toluene extraction, Celite filtration, hexanes layering at -35 °C; vapor-diffusion crystals from toluene/hexane

synthesis.procedure: Under argon/anaerobic conditions, finely ground CeI3 (48 mg, 0.092 mmol) was added to a pale orange DMF (3 mL) solution of K3L^tBu (57 mg, 0.088 mmol). After CeI3 dissolved (~5 min), volatiles were removed in vacuo (~2 h). The residue was extracted into toluene (4 mL), filtered through Celite, dried, re-extracted into toluene (2 mL), filtered again, concentrated to <1 mL, and layered with hexanes (~5 mL). Storage at -35 °C for 24 h gave pale orange crystals.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon/anaerobic conditions, finely ground NdCl3 (47 mg, 0.188 mmol) was added to a pale orange DMF (4 mL) solution of K3L^tBu (114 mg, 0.174 mmol). After NdCl3 dissolved (~10 min), volatiles were removed in vacuo (~3 h). The residue was extracted into toluene (4 mL), filtered through Celite, dried, re-extracted into toluene (2 mL), filtered again, concentrated to <1 mL, and layered with hexanes (~6 mL). Storage at -35 °C for 24 h gave pale purple crystals.

synthesis.procedure: To a yellow toluene (2 mL) solution of Ce[N(SiMe3)2]3 (28 mg, 0.045 mmol) was added H3L^tBu (27 mg, 0.050 mmol) as a white powder. Gentle heating for ~30 min solubilized the ligand and turned the solution orange. After cooling, the mixture was filtered through Celite, dried in vacuo, extracted into hexanes (twice), and filtered. A small amount of pale orange crystals for X-ray analysis were grown at -35 °C by toluene/hexane vapor diffusion. Crude characterization material was isolated as an orange powder after hexanes extraction and drying (26 mg, 85% crude).
synthesis.temperature: gentle heating then room temperature; crystallization at -35 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: protonolysis in toluene; Celite filtration; vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Celite filtration, vacuum drying, hexanes extraction; pale orange crystals from toluene/hexane vapor diffusion at -35 °C

synthesis.procedure: A toluene (2 mL) suspension of H3L^tBu (28.2 mg, 0.052 mmol) was heated until a colorless solution formed (~45 min). After cooling to room temperature, Nd[N(SiMe3)2]3 (28.6 mg, 0.046 mmol, 0.9 equiv) was added. After 30 min stirring (pale purple), the solution was filtered through Celite, dried, extracted into hexanes (4 mL), filtered, dried, extracted into Et2O (1 mL), and filtered again. The filtrate was concentrated to <1 mL and set as reverse vapor diffusion with hexanes (~2 mL). Storage at -35 °C for 24 h gave pale purple crystals.
synthesis.temperature: heating to dissolve ligand, then room temperature; crystallization at -35 °C
synthesis.time: ~45 min ligand dissolution; 30 min after metal addition; 24 h crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: protonolysis in toluene; repeated Celite filtrations; reverse vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Celite filtration, hexanes then Et2O extraction, reverse vapor diffusion with hexanes at -35 °C
